Product description

Product Description

UltraDEX One go mint mouthwash - 10 x 15ml sachets UltraDEX One go sachets are an easy to use solution for fresh breath when on the go. The solution uses UltraDEX Advanced IQ+ ActiveOxi Technology that is proven to eliminate the source of bad breath. Each sachet provides up to 12 hours of fresh breath. The convenient UltraDEX One go liquid sachets provide 12 hour fresh breath confidence when you are on the go. Developed and recommended by dental Professionals; rinsing rinse with 15ml of mouthwash from one sachet is all it takes to eliminate bad breath on contact for 12 hour fresh breath confidence. Contains IQ ActiveOxi Technology.Just one sachet.

Ingredients

Aqua, Polysorbate 20, PEG-60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Glycerin, Aroma, Sodium Saccharin, Trisodium Phosphate, Sodium Monofluorophosphate, Sodium Benzoate, Sodium Chlorite, Sodium Citrate, Citric Acid, Menthol, Sodium Bicarbonate, Limonene

Directions

Simply tear off the end strip as shown and pour the liquid directly into your mouth. Rinse around the mouth for 30 seconds and do not swallow. Do not rinse with water after use.

Safety Warning

Caution: Do not swallow. Not suitable for children 6 years and under. Do not store in direct sunlight.

See more

From the manufacturer

12 Hour Fresh Breath Confidence

Unlike most other mouthwashes, UltraDEX doesn't just mask bad breath odour with a minty flavour, it actually destroys the Volatile Sulphur Compounds (VSC) that are the root cause. Clinically proven to keep breath fresh for 12 hours.

Daily Protection

UltraDEX provides extra protection for teeth and gums. Developed by one of the leading dental experts, the technology inhibits harmful bacteria and plaque which can otherwise lead to tooth decay and gum problems.

Clinically Proven Technology

The advanced technology within UltraDEX products works with your natural oral pH, releasing just the right amount of active ingredient your mouth needs to ensure it stays fresh, clean and healthy all day long.

Premium Oral Care

Daily use of UltraDEX will also help to restore natural whiteness to teeth as it gently oxidises everyday stains such as tea, coffee, red wine and tobacco. All UltraDEX products are also free from alcohol, chlorhexidine and sulphates.
